name: Conditional SU2 force bounds and continuous response v3
body:
This frozen snapshot preserves the corrected SU2 reference-family audit, additive continuous force bounds and conditional continuous-PDE energy comparison. It also contains the earlier particle branch/body-force diagnostics and preserved failures.

The original source-lag receipt used a different MMS and is withdrawn from interpretation as the executed SU2 study. Raw solver archives and acceptance thresholds are unchanged. Corrected forcing uses the archived sigma/nu and executed exponential-envelope reference.

Envelope-aware real-domain force upper endpoints are approximately 0.239437, 0.119659 and 0.059815. Conditional volume-normalized continuous L2 response upper endpoints at T=.05 are approximately 0.0215293, 0.0107593 and 0.00537832. The latter assumes incompressible spatially smooth solutions, identical initial data/viscosity, an energy identity and bounded analytic forcing lag. It includes an ideal sample-and-hold comparison, not the discrete SU2 update. It does not prove solution existence or attribute observed solver error.

Validation scope: publication fb35ac5 passed 377 local tests, one skip and 89 subtests. Subsequent input-chain controls (six tests) and response-constant controls (three tests) pass separately. Guarded same-host exports reproduce corrected forcing and envelope JSON. Interval bounds and exact schedule controls are preserved. These do not constitute a full-suite result at this snapshot, cross-host success, native cloud execution or physical proof.

Reviewer files: reports/su2-source-lag-reference-correction-2026-10-04.md, reports/su2-force-envelope-upper-2026-10-04.md, reports/su2-continuous-response-2026-10-04.md. Rational upper endpoints and provenance are under evidence/su2-force-envelope-upper-v2 and evidence/su2-continuous-response-v3. Use rational endpoints for certificates, not rounded displays.

Hosted Python run 37158068332 at fb35ac5 is still queued on a fresh no-cache read. This tag publication preserves its pending verification instead of replacing the PR head. Global derivative bounds, solver attribution, unresolved proof identities, physical hypotheses and final integration remain open. No new upstream issue is justified by the conditional estimates.
